title: Extended TMDB Schema — Review, List, Certification, Config
acceptance_criteria: Review model: id, tmdbId, author, authorDetails (username, name, avatarPath, rating), content, createdAt, updatedAt, url, iso6391, mediaType, mediaId, mediaTitle, mediaPosterPath, mediaReleaseDate, rating, language
TmdbList model: id, tmdbId, name, description, language, itemCount, createdBy (userId, username), public, sortBy, createdAt, updatedAt
TmdbListItem model: id, listId FK, mediaType, mediaId, title, originalTitle, overview, releaseDate, posterPath, mediaRating, popularity
Certification model: id, iso31661, certification, meaning, order (unique on iso31661+certification)
WatchProvider updated: add flatrate/rent/buy/free distinction with region support
WatchProviderRegion model: id, providerId FK, region (iso31661)
TmdbConfiguration model: id, imageUrl, logoPath, posterPath, backdropPath, profilePath, stillPath, changeKeys (JSON)
All junction tables with proper unique constraints
deliverables: prisma/schema.prisma (extended with review, list, certification, config models)
